title: SLA sweep
prompt: Our urgent tickets are slipping. Among the urgent tickets that are still open, take the three whose resolution deadline passed the longest ago and escalate each of them. Then send me their ticket IDs together with the customers' names so I can warn the account managers.

calls.args: {"query":"list tickets filter by priority urgent status open"}

agent_text.text:
I escalated the three open urgent tickets with the oldest resolution deadlines. Each is now at escalation level 1. The ticket list had 9 open urgent tickets.

| Ticket | Customer | Resolution was due | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-1717 | Marcus Roberts (C-0310, Morse-Anderson) | 2026-03-25 | Order O-0739 marked delivered but nothing arrived |
| T-1227 | Dana Richardson (C-0232, Acosta, Garcia and Moreno) | 2026-03-26 | Charged twice for order O-0418 |
| T-0931 | Reginald Padilla (C-0113, no company on file) | 2026-04-02 | Wrong item received in order O-0229 |

- **Priority:** The tickets were already urgent, so escalation did not change their priority.
- **Assignees:** The assignees are unchanged, and each ticket got an internal note with the reason for escalation.
- **Deadlines:** All three deadlines passed about two months ago, as of 2026-06-01.

I did not send anything to the account managers. The table above is what you can forward to them.
